move.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your offer and for taking the time to review our enquiry; we value our longstanding relationship and recognize that late invoice payments have caused you difficulty. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all with Zerspanung Dralveck. Would you be willing to review your costing against current material prices and revisit your offer?

Another bidder offers EUR 31.50 per unit for this part (offer:70240-0).
Electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your on-time delivery was 80.8% in 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 27.86 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, for our full demand of 4200 units a year over 24 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
